# Summit Lakeside Rentals

> Five direct-booking lakefront vacation homes in East Stroudsburg, PA, in the
> Pocono Mountains — about 90 minutes from New York City. Four homes sit on
> Lakeside Drive in the gated Penn Estates community, on Lower Twin Lake; the
> Mansion is on Blue Mountain Lake, a gated paddle-only-lake community nearby.
> Every home includes a private hot tub, a fire pit, and free non-motorized
> boats (kayaks, canoes, pedal boats). 837 verified guest reviews, 4.91
> average. Booking direct here costs less than Airbnb or Vrbo — no platform
> service fees — and returning guests get a loyalty discount.

Key facts: check-in 4 PM, check-out 11 AM. The booking guest must be 21+ and
stay on-site. Dogs welcome (up to 3, $100 flat fee per stay); no cats. No
parties; quiet hours 10 PM–8 AM. Full payment is due at booking. The lakes at
the houses are for boating and catch-and-release fishing; swimming is at the
Hyland Lake sandy beach (Penn Estates) and at each community's two
Olympic-size pools (Memorial Day–Labor Day, amenity badges included with
every stay).

## Properties

- [The Lakehouse](https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/poconos-lakefront-with-hot-tub-boats-and-more):
  Lakefront on Lower Twin Lake, sleeps 12. Hot tub, game room, big deck,
  fire pit, and boats on a private dock.
- [The Chalet](https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/luxury-lakefront-chalet-in-poconos-1-5hrs-from-nyc):
  Lake-view A-frame, sleeps 12. Hot tub, sauna, stacked decks, fire pit,
  boats — the ski-season favorite.
- [The Manor](https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/lake-adjacent-home-w-hot-tub-game-room-boats-fenced-yard):
  Lake-adjacent (water access two doors down), sleeps 12. Hot tub, game
  room, boats, and a fully fenced yard — the pick for dog families.
- [The Cottage](https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/cozy-lakefront-home-w-game-room-hot-tub-fire-pit-boats):
  Lakefront, sleeps 8 — the cozy one. Arcade game room, hot tub, fire pit,
  boats.
- [The Mansion](https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/lakefront-mansion-w-3-decks-hot-tub-boats-game-room):
  Lakefront on Blue Mountain Lake, sleeps 12, 3,400+ sq ft. Three decks,
  hot tub, arcade, pool table, bar, boats.

## Booking

- [Search availability](https://www.summitlakeside.com/search): all five
  homes by date and guest count.
- Availability API: GET https://www.summitlakeside.com/api/availability
  with check_in and check_out (YYYY-MM-DD) and optional guests — returns
  available homes with id, slug, and max_guests. No authentication.
- Pricing API: GET https://www.summitlakeside.com/api/checkout/pricing
  with property_id (the id from the availability API), check_in, check_out,
  guests, pets — returns a full quote including cleaning fee, pet fee, and
  Pennsylvania state + Monroe County taxes. No authentication.
- To book: open
  https://www.summitlakeside.com/book/{slug}?check_in=YYYY-MM-DD&check_out=YYYY-MM-DD&guests=N
  and complete checkout (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay).
- [Rental policies](https://www.summitlakeside.com/rental-policies):
  cancellation tiers, deposits, house rules, occupancy.
- [Guest FAQ](https://www.summitlakeside.com/faq): booking, the gate, the
  lake and boats, hot tubs, pets, house rules.
